newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thailand PTT buys Sept fuel oil from Petrodiamond.
newsitem.headline: Thailand PTT buys Sept fuel oil from Petrodiamond.

text.p: State-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) has bought by tender 80,000 tonnes of September delivery 180-cst fuel oil from Japanese trader Petrodiamond at $8.05-$15.00 per tonne premia, industry sources said on Friday.

PTT bought 8,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent sulphur fuel oil at $15 per tonne over spot Singapore quotes and 72,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent at $8.05 per tonne over spot Singapore quotes on a cost and freight basis, the sources said.
The fuel oil is for delivery between September 15-20.

In its last purchase tender, PTT bought 75,000 tonnes of 2.0-percent sulphur and 5,000 tonnes of 1.0-percent fuel oil for August 15-25 delivery at $8.50 per tonne over Singapore spot quotes, c-and-f to Sri Racha.
